description.narrative:
The Project is focused on improving maritime transport connectivity, resilience and safety between the islands, supporting economic integration in Comoros.
Comoros has various untapped growth potentials, but such potential areas remain fragmented because of poor transport connectivity among and within the islands. Poverty is persistently high particularly in remote areas, with regional inequality widening. In addition, Comoros is highly vulnerable to climatic events and natural hazards, such as tropical cyclones, high waves and coastal flooding. Maritime transport safety is becoming a particular concern for local users. The Project addresses efficiency, reliability and safety in both formal and informal (called kwassa kwassa) maritime transport sectors.
The main project objectives are:
- Increased economic resilience by facilitating economic internal exchanges between island as well as external exchanges.
- Reduce disparities in transport infrastructure and improve social well-being.
- Induce increased demand.
- Reduce the cost of transportation for people and goods;
- Reduce travel time;
- Ensure the safety of maritime transport users.
